resume.about-me-text:
I’m a Full-Stack Web Developer with 3+ years of experience building scalable, high-performance web applications using Next.js, Nuxt.js, and NestJS. I specialize in delivering production-ready solutions that combine modern frontend frameworks with solid backend architecture.


Key Services:
- Full-stack web development with Next.js, Nuxt.js, React, Vue, and NestJS
- API development and integration: REST, GraphQL, WebSockets
- Secure authentication and authorization: JWT, OAuth2, role-based access
- Database design and management: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, MySQL, Prisma, TypeORM
- Performance optimization: SSR, SSG, caching, SEO, web performance tuning
- Modern frontend UI/UX: responsive design, component-based architecture, state management (Redux, Pinia, Zustand)
- Collaboration in Agile/Scrum teams to deliver fast, reliable features

Tech Stack: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Vue, Next.js, Nuxt.js, NestJS, Node.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Docker, AWS

I’m looking for remote or hybrid roles where I can contribute to ambitious web projects, deliver clean, maintainable code, and help teams scale products efficiently.
